content:
alex: Free pickup — CalDigit TS3 Plus USB-C docking station (works great) + IKEA Markus chair (black) — moving and can't bring extras. Picking up from SF office (Floor 3 mailroom) today. DM to claim, I'll leave them labeled. Pics later.

sam: is the dock thunderbolt or USB-C only? need it for an M1 MBA.

alex: USB-C only (no TB passthrough). Works fine with M1 if you plug straight into USB-C; some people use a TB->USB-C cable but not required.

maria: @alex I can grab the chair. seat width and height range? any tears?

alex: seat width ~20in, back height ~28in. height range ~18-22in. small scuff on left arm, otherwise clean. no tears.

jordan: i'll take the dock if @sam passes. @alex can you hold it until ~3pm?

sam: if jordan wants it, take it. otherwise i'll stop by around 4pm as backup.

ops-bot: Reminder: please keep giveaways to #random and add a "claim by" time so things don't get left behind :robot_face:

alex: cool — chair -> @maria, dock -> @jordan unless @sam changes their mind. i'll leave both items in the mailroom marked:

```
Pickup: alex
Item: Docking station (CalDigit TS3 Plus) / IKEA Markus chair
Claim by: 3:30pm
Location: Floor 3 mailroom (next to kitchen)
```

maria: claiming the chair! sending you a PM to confirm time. thanks alex :heart:

jordan: thanks, i'll grab the dock after standup.
sam: thanks — if still there by 4pm i'll pick up as backup.

alex: awesome, thanks everyone. leaving a post-it on both items. :thumbsup:
